query:
insert into CoverageLineExcludes (
                        latest_collection,
                        file_hash,
                        line,
                        rational_hash
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4
                    )
                    on conflict (file_hash, line)
                    do update set
                        latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                        rational_hash = excluded.rational_hash
